visible_text:
Beginning next semester, residence-hall
dining rooms will offer an enhanced
selection of vegan menu options.
Some students choose veganism for ethical reasons, out of
concern for the environment and for the treatment of
animals. Raising animals for food contributes greatly to
greenhouse gas emissions and is responsible for significant
water pollution. Other students are motivated by health
considerations, such as food allergies, or by respect for
religious traditions.
Our creative dining hall chefs will
incorporate many new recipes from around
the world that will be irresistible even to
carnivores! Aaron Larsen, who has been
preparing meals at Carson Hall
Dining Room for eight years, says he has
enjoyed learning new recipes and cooking techniques.
“At first I was skeptical about whether we could create
truly satisfying dishes without using animal products,
especially dairy foods,” he said, “but now I’m very proud
of what we are able to offer student diners.”
